verdict.rationale: vLLM's own README and site document installing the published package with uv or pip (`uv pip install vllm --torch-backend auto`). The docs also offer an official prebuilt Docker image (vllm/vllm-openai), and building from source is positioned as an option for development only. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that prebuilt installs work smoothly, and evidence that prebuilt packages exist across the non-NVIDIA hardware targets (AMD, CPU, plugins).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: Install vLLM with uv (recommended) or pip:
vLLM offers an official Docker image for deployment. The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
Or build from source for development.
